scope.statement: Independent exact-head audit of GLOBAL-COLOUR-LIFT-AFFINE-FLATTENING-PR958: for a noncollinear finite planar source, positive lift parameter, and centered regular unit-edge simplex color vectors, the normalized lift (p_i,t z_c(i))/sqrt(1+t^2) has affine dimension at most two iff every centered color-vector column lies in the centered source-plane column space. Two used colors flatten iff their source classes are parallel level lines; three used colors cannot flatten for n >= 4.
scope.domain: Exact centered-matrix rank screens on all noncollinear 3- and 4-point subsets of the 3x3 integer grid with surjective two- or three-color assignments.
scope.limitations: Does not derive a two-color proper coloring from a global minimizer, exclude other planar rearrangements, prove any source is globally minimizing, or promote theorem state. The finite screen is not the proof.

result: The stated affine-rank criterion and its two-/three-color consequences pass the independent proof reconstruction. Exact finite screens found no counterexample in the declared grid domain.
remaining_questions: Show that an actual sufficiently large triangle-free global minimizer admits a proper two-coloring whose classes lie on two parallel lines, or construct a different planar full-source strict-diameter endpoint; the submitted candidate proves neither.
